sql: SELECT SUM(VLEClicks) AS TotalVLEClicks FROM oulad_dw.vle_clicks

SELECT 
    code_module,
    COUNT(*) AS total_clicks
FROM 
    oulad_dw.clicks
GROUP BY 
    code_module

SELECT code_presentation, SUM(clicks) AS total_clicks
FROM oulad_dw
WHERE module = 'BBB'
GROUP BY code_presentation

SELECT activity_type, SUM(clicks) AS total_clicks
FROM oulad_dw.activity_data
GROUP BY activity_type
ORDER BY total_clicks DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT activity_group, SUM(total_clicks) AS total_clicks
FROM oulad_dw
WHERE activity_group != 'No Activity'
GROUP BY activity_group

SELECT 
    week_num,
    SUM(clicks) AS total_clicks
FROM 
    oulad_dw
WHERE 
    presentation_id = 'DDD-2013B'
    AND course_week BETWEEN 1 AND 10
GROUP BY 
    week_num

SELECT code_presentation, COUNT(*) AS student_count
FROM oulad_dw.student_enrollment
WHERE module_code = 'AAA'
GROUP BY code_presentation

SELECT 
    code_module,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN withdrawal_status = 'withdrawn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100 / COUNT(*)::DECIMAL, 1) AS withdrawal_rate_percentage
FROM 
    oulad_dw
WHERE 
    enrollment_status = 'enrolled'
GROUP BY 
    code_module

SELECT final_result, COUNT(*) AS student_count
FROM oulad_dw
WHERE final_result = 'CCC-2014J'
GROUP BY final_result

SELECT 
    code_module,
    ROUND(AVG(score), 1) AS average_score
FROM 
    oulad_dw
WHERE 
    submission_status != 'banked'
GROUP BY 
    code_module

SELECT 
    assessment_type,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN submission_date > due_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100 / COUNT(*), 1) AS percentage
FROM 
    oulad_dw.submissions
GROUP BY 
    assessment_type

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) 
FROM oulad_dw.bbb_2014j_forum_activity 
WHERE activity_type = 'forum' AND course_week = 1

SELECT 
    code_presentation,
    ROUND(SUM(clicks) / COUNT(DISTINCT student_id), 1) AS average_clicks_per_student
FROM 
    oulad_dw
WHERE 
    module_code = 'EEE'
GROUP BY 
    code_presentation

SELECT 
    code_presentation,
    SUM(clicks) AS total_clicks
FROM 
    oulad_dw
WHERE 
    week_num <= 0 AND code_module = 'GGG'
GROUP BY 
    code_presentation

SELECT 
    code_presentation, 
    SUM(clicks) AS total_clicks
FROM 
    oulad_dw.quiz_activity
WHERE 
    code_module = 'CCC'
    AND code_presentation IN ('2014B', '2014J')
GROUP BY 
    code_presentation

SELECT 
    outcome_group,
    ROUND(AVG(total_clicks), 1) AS avg_total_clicks
FROM 
    oulad_dw
WHERE 
    semester = 'FFF-2014J'
    AND week BETWEEN 1 AND 4
GROUP BY 
    outcome_group

SELECT 
    mp.module_presentation,
    COUNT(mp.student_id) AS zero_click_count
FROM 
    module_presentation mp
JOIN 
    click_log cl ON mp.student_id = cl.student_id AND cl.course_week = 1
WHERE 
    cl.clicks = 0
GROUP BY 
    mp.module_presentation

SELECT 
    AVG(CASE WHEN T1.course_week = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS average_active_days
FROM 
    oulad_dw.bbb_2013j_clicks AS T1
JOIN 
    oulad_dw.students AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id
WHERE 
    T1.course_year = 'BBB-2013J'
GROUP BY 
    T2.student_id

SELECT 
    s.gender,
    COUNT(p.id) AS total_clicks
FROM 
    students s
JOIN 
    presentation p ON s.student_id = p.student_id
GROUP BY 
    s.gender

SELECT 
    highest_education,
    COUNT(*) AS enrollment_count
FROM 
    oulad_dw.enrollments
WHERE 
    result = 'Distinction'
GROUP BY 
    highest_education

SELECT 
    id_assessment,
    due_day,
    ROUND(AVG(score) OVER (PARTITION BY id_assessment, due_day EXCEPT SELECT id_assessment, due_day FROM oulad_dw WHERE submission_type = 'banked'), 1)
FROM 
    oulad_dw
WHERE 
    submission_type != 'banked'
AND 
    id_assessment IN ('AAA-2013J')

WITH ClicksByModule AS (
    SELECT 
        code_module,
        code_presentation,
        SUM(clicks) AS total_clicks
    FROM 
        oulad_dw.clicks
    GROUP BY 
        code_module, 
        code_presentation
),
ModuleSubtotals AS (
    SELECT 
        code_module,
        SUM(total_clicks) AS subtotal
    FROM 
        ClicksByModule
    GROUP BY 
        code_module
)
SELECT 
    code_module,
    code_presentation,
    total_clicks,
    subtotal
FROM 
    ClicksByModule
JOIN 
    ModuleSubtotals ON ClicksByModule.code_module = ModuleSubtotals.code_module
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'Grand Total',
    NULL,
    SUM(total_clicks),
    NULL
FROM 
    ClicksByModule

SELECT 
    mp.module_presentation,
    ROUND(SUM(cp.clicks) / COUNT(DISTINCT cp.enrolled_student_id), 1) AS average_clicks_per_enrolled_student
FROM 
    module_presentation mp
JOIN 
    click_performance cp ON mp.module_presentation_id = cp.module_presentation_id
GROUP BY 
    mp.module_presentation
ORDER BY 
    average_clicks_per_enrolled_student DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    code_module,
    assessment_type,
    COUNT(*) AS assessment_count
FROM 
    oulad_dw.assessments
GROUP BY 
    code_module, 
    assessment_type

SELECT 
    code_module,
    ROUND(AVG(days_late), 1) AS avg_days_late
FROM 
    oulad_dw
WHERE 
    submission_date > DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
GROUP BY 
    code_module

SELECT 
    phase,
    SUM(clicks) AS total_clicks
FROM 
    oulad_dw.presentation_clicks
GROUP BY 
    phase

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_students
FROM (
    SELECT student_id, course_week
    FROM oulad_dw.demographics
    WHERE course_week IN (1, 2, 3, 4)
) AS filtered_students
GROUP BY course_week

SELECT 
    num_of_prev_attempts,
    COUNT(*) AS count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'withdrawn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100 / COUNT(*), 1) AS percentage
FROM 
    oulad_dw.enrollments
GROUP BY 
    num_of_prev_attempts

SELECT 
    activity_group,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN click_type = 'click' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100 / COUNT(*), 1) AS percentage
FROM 
    oulad_dw.clicks
WHERE 
    activity_group != 'no_activity'
GROUP BY 
    activity_group

SELECT final_result, ROUND(AVG(studied_credits), 1) AS average_studied_credits
FROM oulad_dw
GROUP BY final_result

SELECT 
    term_name,
    SUM(clicks) AS total_clicks
FROM 
    oulad_dw
WHERE 
    presentation_date BETWEEN '2023-02-01' AND '2023-02-29'
    OR presentation_date BETWEEN '2023-10-01' AND '2023-10-31'
GROUP BY 
    term_name

SELECT code_module, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM oulad_dw.presentations
WHERE presentation_date = '2014-01-01' -- Replace with your desired date range
GROUP BY code_module

SELECT 
    activity_group,
    SUM(CASE WHEN course_week = 1 THEN clicks ELSE 0 END) AS week1,
    SUM(CASE WHEN course_week = 2 THEN clicks ELSE 0 END) AS week2,
    SUM(CASE WHEN course_week = 3 THEN clicks ELSE 0 END) AS week3
FROM 
    oulad_dw
WHERE 
    activity_group IN ('AAA-2014J')
GROUP BY 
    activity_group

SELECT 
    module_presentation,
    ROUND(AVG(exam_score), 1) AS average_score
FROM 
    oulad_dw
GROUP BY 
    module_presentation

SELECT 
    module_presentation,
    COUNT(*) AS student_count
FROM 
    oulad_dw.student_module_presentations
WHERE 
    late_submission IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
    module_presentation

SELECT outcome_group, SUM(clicks) AS total_clicks
FROM oulad_dw.bbb_2014b
WHERE activity_type = 'oucontent'
GROUP BY outcome_group

SELECT MAX(clicks) AS max_clicks
FROM oulad_dw
WHERE course_week = 'FFF-2014J'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT activity_type) 
FROM oulad_dw 
WHERE event_name = 'click' AND date BETWEEN '2014-07-01' AND '2014-07-31'

SELECT 
    code_module,
    COUNT(*) AS count
FROM 
    oulad_dw.enrollments
WHERE 
    date_registration < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 100 DAY)
GROUP BY 
    code_module

SELECT 
    final_result,
    ROUND(AVG(total_clicks) / COUNT(DISTINCT enrollment_id), 1) AS avg_total_clicks_per_enrollment
FROM 
    oulad_dw.ccc
WHERE 
    module = 'CCC'
GROUP BY 
    final_result
